_comment: Group versions of the moves that can hold two or three characters at once. The library's recipes are written around one subject (the orbit circles <Subject 1>, and the group's action then happens after it). These keep the same camera clause but aim it at the whole group, and put the action inside the move. {GROUP} is '<Subject 1> and <Subject 2>', {N_SHOT} is 'two-shot' or 'three-shot', {N_PEOPLE} is 'the two of them' or 'the three of them'. A move is offered for a group only when `tested` is true: a group render of it was watched and held up.

orbit-360.line: A medium {N_SHOT} frames {GROUP} standing close together {PLACE}, facing each other, with {ENVIRONMENT_ELEMENTS} behind them. The camera performs an arc shot around {GROUP} with large amplitude at fast speed, sweeping one complete circle around {N_PEOPLE} together and coming back to the front, keeping everyone in frame the whole time. They stay where they are through the sweep.

aerial-pullback.line: A medium {N_SHOT} frames {GROUP} standing together {PLACE}, with {ENVIRONMENT_ELEMENTS} behind them. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed while pedestalling up, rising and retreating until {N_PEOPLE} are small figures far below and the whole {LOCATION} opens out around them.
aerial-pullback.lead: As the camera rises away from them,

crane-rise.line: A medium {N_SHOT} frames {GROUP} running side by side {PLACE}, hair flying and clothing snapping with the movement, with {ENVIRONMENT_ELEMENTS} behind them. The camera starts low at ground level beside them as they move, then performs a tracking shot with large amplitude at fast speed, pedestalling up and tilting down to follow {N_PEOPLE} from high overhead while they stay centred and sharp in frame.

handheld.line: A medium {N_SHOT} frames {GROUP} running side by side {PLACE}, hair flying and clothing snapping with the movement, with {ENVIRONMENT_ELEMENTS} behind them. The camera shakes strongly at fast speed while performing a tracking shot alongside {N_PEOPLE} as they move, the frame lurching and correcting with every stride.

dutch-angle.line: A medium {N_SHOT} frames {GROUP} standing together {PLACE}, with {ENVIRONMENT_ELEMENTS} behind them. The camera rolls {ROLL_DIRECTION} into a canted dutch angle and holds there, the horizon tilted, {N_PEOPLE} off-axis.
